parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH src AS (
  SELECT
    $1::uuid AS conv_id,
    $2::integer AS chatwoot_conv_id,
    $3::integer AS chatwoot_contact_id,
    NULLIF($4, '')::text AS resumen_ia,
    NULLIF($5, '')::text AS plan_interes,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), 'ALTO')::text AS nivel_interes,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), 'Cliente')::text AS nombre_cliente,
    NULLIF($8, '')::text AS telefono,
    COALESCE(NULLIF($9, ''), 'UNKNOWN')::text AS marca,
    NULLIF($10, '')::text AS modelo
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO transferencias_humano (
    conversacion_id, conversation_id, chatwoot_conv_id, chatwoot_contact_id,
    nombre_cliente, telefono, marca, modelo,
    asesor_nombre, asesor_asignado,
    resumen_conversacion, resumen_ia, plan_interes, plan_sugerido,
    razon_transferencia, nivel_interes, estado_handoff, notificado_chatwoot, notificado_at
  )
  SELECT
    conv_id, conv_id, chatwoot_conv_id, chatwoot_contact_id,
    nombre_cliente, telefono, marca, modelo,
    'Equipo QuickLink', 'Equipo QuickLink',
    COALESCE(resumen_ia, 'Handoff iniciado desde CRIS'),
    COALESCE(resumen_ia, 'Handoff iniciado desde CRIS'),
    plan_interes, plan_interes,
    'handoff_cris', nivel_interes, 'INICIADO', true, now()
  FROM src
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transferencias_humano th
    WHERE th.conversacion_id = src.conv_id
       OR th.conversation_id = src.conv_id
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT th.id
FROM transferencias_humano th, src
WHERE th.conversacion_id = src.conv_id
   OR th.conversation_id = src.conv_id
LIMIT 1

parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH state_result AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM set_conversation_state($1::uuid, 'HANDOFF_HUMAN', 'cris_handoff_chatwoot', jsonb_build_object('workflow', 'CRIS-03'))
), conv AS (
  SELECT c.id, c.lead_id
  FROM conversaciones c
  JOIN state_result sr ON sr.conversation_id = c.id
  WHERE sr.changed OR sr.reason = 'no_change'
), mem AS (
  UPDATE lead_memory lm
  SET conversation_state = 'HANDOFF_HUMAN',
      asesor_requerido = true,
      outbound_sequence_status = 'PAUSED',
      customer_engaged = true,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM conv
  WHERE lm.conversation_id = conv.id
     OR lm.lead_id = conv.lead_id
  RETURNING lm.phone
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM conv) AS conv_id, COUNT(*)::integer AS memory_rows, (SELECT reason FROM state_result) AS state_reason FROM mem
